create_wizard_dict_agent: create a WizardDictAgent instance with options to load or initialize a dictionary for tokenization
tokenize_text_whitespace: tokenize text into whitespace-separated tokens using the WizardDictAgent tokenize method
tokenize_text_regex: tokenize text using regex pattern matching via the re_tokenize method to split on whitespace and punctuation
load_dictionary_from_file: load a pre-existing dictionary file into the WizardDictAgent using the dict_file option
add_special_tokens: add special tokens like PAD, SOC, and UNK to the WizardDictAgent dictionary
